about: Hand labels for the recognizer evaluation. Each photo lists what is actually in it and which chart rows are right for each item. rows: acceptable row ids (null = no chart row fits, so the app should say Check). ambiguous: the right row can't be told from the photo, so the item is left out of the safety count. unclear: contents can't be seen; any Toss or Check answer is fine, a Keep is counted as 'unclear kept'. All items are in the fridge. Labeled by looking at the full-size photos.
